index.section_actions: What do you want to do?
index.section_traces_note: Evidence from real smokes — step through serial/KTM events.
index.intro_what: IR0 is an independent Unix-like kernel. It is not a Linux fork and not a distro — ISD is the rootfs and the userspace product.
index.intro_philosophy: Where it can, IR0 honors the contracts existing programs already speak: Linux syscall ABI, /dev/fb0, evdev, TTY. The work is making the kernel right, not patching every app.
index.intro_guide: This site is a guide, not the spec. Contracts live in IR0/Documentation and mandocs at the pinned edition.
index.aside_docs_body: IR0/Documentation and mandocs explain how IR0 is built. Explore IR0 shows what happens when you use the machine — then links you to the spec.
index.aside_hierarchy_body: This site tells the story · the code proves it · mandocs hold the contract.
